name: Inchworm + Push-Up
instructions: From standing, fold forward and walk your hands out to a plank.
Perform one push-up at full extension.
Walk the hands back to your feet and stand up.
Repeat. A full-body warm-up combining stretch, core, and pressing.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Inchworm + Push-Up is a beginner core exercise targeting the abs, performed with just your bodyweight. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
